question: Should Twilio RCS ship as a bundled OpenClaw channel, or as an externally maintained plugin using the existing channel SDK?
rationale: The channel is a new optional service integration, the plugin seams already support its implementation, and VISION.md sets a high bar for optional plugins in core; this is a product and ownership choice rather than a mechanical review repair.

options.title: Ship as an external plugin
options.body: Move the RCS package to an independently maintained plugin/ClawHub distribution and retain only any proven generic SDK seam in core.

options.title: Sponsor bundled ownership
options.body: Accept bundled ownership only with an explicit maintainer rationale, current-head dependency authorization, upgrade-safe SMS behavior, and inspectable carrier/device proof.

options.title: Defer the feature
options.body: Pause this PR until demand, ownership, and live RCS validation justify either distribution path.

recommendation.title: Ship as an external plugin
recommendation.body: Move the RCS package to an independently maintained plugin/ClawHub distribution and retain only any proven generic SDK seam in core.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the closest bundled Twilio channel and are best positioned to judge whether RCS warrants the same distribution and ownership model.
